mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies at 64 degrees near Reddan Soccer Park under a waxing crescent moon. Also, keep your eyes peeled at 4:47 AM for a 4-minute ISS pass traveling from Belleville toward Fitchburg, appearing low on the horizon.

In city news, the Senior Center is looking for volunteers for their various programs, and please note that construction on Highway M starts August 18, which will shift traffic patterns for the next few weeks.

Today, Epic Systems is hosting their UGM, while tomorrow features trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee. On Wednesday, check out the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park or join the trivia night at The Bogey Factory.
In police news, on August 6, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in the arrest of a driver for an O W I, fourth offence.
Today's featured flavor is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. Since the store is currently closed, make sure to head over once they open at 10 AM to get your scoop.
